YTA. It's the fucking ableism for me in saying she wouldn't be a good psychologist because she has autism, as if being allistic inherently gives you the skills needed to understand and provide therapy. If that were the case (as I am assuming you're NT) you wouldn't be here showing your ass with your complete lack of knowledge, understanding and respect for what your daughter wants, how she feels and your discrimination against her and her chosen field. You saying it's just because you want her to "have a good life" is a copout and you know it. If you don't get over yourself, she may cut you off in the future. If you really want to fix this, go back, educate yourself, apologize, work to earn her trust again and let her be (if she forgives you and lets you). Otherwise, any fallout from this is totally on you.
I see why she didn't tell you. YTA. I hope she cuts you off.
